title: Nice frosted glass, not a fan of the scent.
text:
Nice frosted glass, not a fan of the scent.. Lovely looking light lavender frosted glass candle holder.
Nice presentation.

I could not figure out the scent to this, its very faint.
I had to almost burn my nose to smell this, but after acouple of hours I could smell it in my home.
But not a fan of the scent.

features: Light up & breathe in - create ambiance and warmth with a divinely scented single wick soy candle (8Oz) with a burn time of 40+ hours. Made of soy & paraffin wax blend
Lift your mood - open, light, and breathe in our dreamy, decadent combinations created to captivate your senses
The perfect household candle - use in every bathroom, in the kitchen, or give it away in a luxury infused gift basket for bridal, baby shower, or mother's day gifts

Mix + match - these beautiful glass, soy candles come in the same fresh fragrances as our Via Mercato soaps, inspired by the markets of Italy. Color coordinate your Via Mercato candle with our oversized match set (50 count), available in multiple colors
description: Via: veeya. Traveling through (a place) en route to a destination. mercato: mer-ka-toe. Italian word for market. it starts with love, as do all things made in Italy. A love of beauty, artistry and quality found throughout the local markets. A curated assortment of modern fragrances inspired by journeys through those markets that celebrate flavors, aroma and life.
